comments.zh: 反向翻转时不消费（特性侧 F3 同语义——反向按类型转换路径处理，跨类型 string→int 无路径将抛
comments.en: During reverse flipping, no consumption occurs (semantic equivalence on the attribute side, F3 — reverse processing follows type conversion paths; cross-type conversions such as string→int without a defined path will throw a MapException). Therefore, reverse demonstrations use same-type property pairs.</para>
